definition: A waymark document inside the repository that carries local work state; both map and task are tickets. A record item is a waymark document too, but it is not a ticket.
avoid: issue (issues live on a remote tracker, not in the repository)

definition: An item on a remote issue tracker, outside the repository: a work item on that tracker or a message to a teammate. It is not local state.
The record of a grill: the question tree and what a person said while a decision was discussed, including the alternatives that lost. It is a waymark record item, not a work item.
avoid: attachment (when it implies a work item)

definition: The grill's refinement tree of open questions, where a child is a narrower part of its parent and siblings are parallel.
avoid: design tree (ambiguous with the target tree)

definition: The questions in the question tree whose prerequisites are settled, asked together in one round.
avoid: frontier (that is the waymark work frontier)

definition: A relation between maps that carries order: one map waits for another to finish. The edge gates the waiting map's acceptance, not every task under it.
avoid: prerequisite (when the direction is not made explicit)

definition: A map whose own dependency edge is unfinished; the edge gates the map's acceptance, not every task under it.
avoid: blocked (for a task waiting on a person; that is `waiting_on`)

definition: Moving a settled question to the target tree as work; the work item hangs under a map, not the testimony.
An operation an owner performs on their own work item: changing its content, relations, status, or ownership.
avoid: modify (when the actor is not specified)

definition: The branch of advance that changes a node other nodes already rely on, sorted by two tests into edit in place, strike and reopen, or retire and replace.
avoid: advance (when such a node's content is meant)
move (a move is one kind of update, not a synonym)

definition: The accountable party of a ticket: the person who advances it and decides whether it passes.
avoid: author (when the accountable party is meant)
assignee (a claim changes who is advancing, not who owns)

definition: The set of work items with no unfinished dependencies that can be started now.
avoid: next actions (when referring to a personal list)
askable set (the grill's questions are not work)

definition: One numbered line inside a task's Action; it has no acceptance signal and is never a target-tree node.
A delivery task's failure: the promised output is missing or short of its acceptance signal, so someone must recover.
avoid: error (when describing the contractual weight of a failed delivery)

definition: Whether a map or task can be started now, judged by its own unfinished dependencies rather than a blocked ancestor.
avoid: scheduling (readiness is about waiting, not about order of importance)

definition: A symmetric association between two items that marks something worth following and carries no order.
The YAML header block of a ticket, carrying the structured fields while the map sections are body text.
avoid: header (when it means the body's heading)
metadata block (when the actor is not specified)

definition: A remote issue carrying one message between two owners in this project's format: its body opens with frontmatter naming the sender, the single recipient, the related tickets, and the message category. It is not local state; the ticket it names is where any decision lands.
avoid: message (when the meaning is the issue itself)

definition: A pass over the whole project that reports where two targets, a promise and its artifact, or two rules contradict each other, into one report, and changes no ticket. The read that steps out of the current ticket; it judges nothing.

The file written before a restart, listing what still holds, which words and decisions survive, and the dead ends not to repeat. It is what the new root cites and what a reader of the failed attempt opens.

Two parts of a project that contradict each other: two targets, a promise and its artifact, or two rules. It has to name both sides and be citable at each; one side alone is a preference, not a conflict.
A record of one whole task: when it is done, the thing it names can be done. It names the spec it came from and says what to do, what counts as done, what was left behind, and what blocks it.
avoid: issue (issues live on a remote tracker, not in the repository)

definition: The record of a discussion: each round's questions, the recommended answer, what the person said, the decisions reached, and what was left open.
The structure of a discussion, recovered from each question's Parent line rather than drawn a second time.
avoid: target tree (no such thing in this set)

definition: The questions whose prerequisites are settled, asked together in one round. The skill calls it the frontier.
A relation between two tickets that carries order: one waits for the other to finish. Blocking is the only relation between tickets.
avoid: prerequisite (when the direction is not made explicit)

definition: A ticket whose own dependency is unfinished. It says nothing about the other tickets around it.
avoid: waiting on a person (that is not a dependency)

definition: What a discussion produced, written as work lines for whoever asked for it. The discussion does not open the work itself.
The accountable party of a record: the person who advances it and decides whether it passes. It differs from the creator, who only wrote it down.
avoid: author (when the accountable party is meant)

definition: An operation an owner performs on a record they own: changing its content, relations, status, or ownership.
avoid: modify (when the actor is not specified)

definition: The branch of advance that changes a record other records already rely on.
avoid: advance (when such a record's content is meant)

definition: The tickets whose blockers are all done, and so can be started now.
avoid: next actions (when referring to a personal list)
askable set (a discussion's questions are not work)

definition: One line inside a ticket's work. It has no acceptance criteria of its own, and a ticket made only of steps is not whole.
A finished ticket whose result is missing or short of its acceptance criteria, so someone has to recover.
avoid: error (when describing the weight of a failed delivery)

definition: Whether a ticket can be started now, judged by its own unfinished blockers.
avoid: scheduling (readiness is about waiting, not about order of importance)

definition: A symmetric association between two records that marks something worth following and carries no order.
The YAML header block of a record, carrying the structured fields while the body carries the prose.
avoid: header (when it means the body's heading)
metadata block (when the actor is not specified)

definition: A remote issue carrying one message between two owners in this project's format: its body opens with frontmatter naming the sender, the single recipient, the related records, and the message category. It is not local state.
avoid: message (when the meaning is the issue itself)

definition: A pass over the whole project that reports where two records, a promise and its artifact, or two rules contradict each other, into one report, and changes nothing. It judges nothing.
The file written before a restart, listing what still holds, which words and decisions survive, and the dead ends not to repeat.

Two parts of a project that contradict each other: two records, a promise and its artifact, or two rules. It has to name both sides and be citable at each; one side alone is a preference, not a conflict.

A record of one change: the problem, the solution, the decisions that were settled, what is handed over and how a reader tells it was, and what was left out. Tickets are cut from it, and nothing else is cut.
What a finished ticket left behind, in one or two lines and in a form a later reader can point at. It is written when the ticket is finished, not when it is cut.
avoid: output (when it names something a reader cannot point at)

definition: Whoever works one ticket: a person or an agent, never both. A ticket needing a person is its own ticket however small.
avoid: owner (the arranger is not always the owner)

definition: One task that can be done in a single sitting: when it is done, the thing it names can be done. A task that only prepares for another is not whole, and a task holding two is not one task.

How a reader tells a spec's delivery was handed over: one sentence naming what is handed over, then one to three lines naming how a reader tells it was. Judged at the finished thing, not at a step toward it.
avoid: acceptance criteria (that is a ticket's checklist)
